title: JavaScript fundamentals
description: Equality, scope, prototypes and the two or three things every interview asks about.

questions.text: What does `===` compare that `==` does not?
questions.explanation: `==` coerces, `===` does not: `'1' == 1` is true, `'1' === 1` is false.
